```{r}
# run twice 
library(Matrix)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("wakefulness_to_R.csv") %>%
 filter(is_peak %in% c(1),
        sov %in% c("wnbeg", "wnend","wmbeg", "wmend"),
        cond %in% c("Bl0T1", "Bl0T2"))

# Create the nested structure
# First extract the main sov factor (wn vs wm)
data$sov_main <- substr(data$sov, 1, 2)
# Then extract the bedOrEnd factor (beg vs end)
data$bedOrEnd <- substr(data$sov, 3, 5)

data$sov <- as.factor(data$sov)
data$sov_main <- as.factor(data$sov_main)
data$bedOrEnd <- as.factor(data$bedOrEnd)
data$component <- as.factor(data$component)
data$is_peak <- as.factor(data$is_peak)
data$cond <- factor(data$cond, 
                    levels = c("Bl0T1", "Bl0T2"), 
                    ordered = TRUE)

N100_data <- subset(data, component == "N100")
P2_data <- subset(data, component == "P2")
N350_data <- subset(data, component == "N350")
```

```{r}
analyze_component <- function(comp_data, comp_name) {
  # Fit models with nested structure
  null_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ 1 + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  
  # Main effects model with nested factors
  main_effects_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov_main + bedOrEnd + cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  
  # Model with interactions between main factors
  interaction_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd * cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  
  # Test for main effects
  sov_main_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov_main + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  sov_main_comparison <- anova(null_model, sov_main_model)
  
  bedOrEnd_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ bedOrEnd + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  bedOrEnd_comparison <- anova(null_model, bedOrEnd_model)
  
  cond_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  cond_comparison <- anova(null_model, cond_model)
  
  # Test for two-way interactions
  sov_bedOrEnd_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  sov_bedOrEnd_comparison <- anova(main_effects_model, sov_bedOrEnd_model)
  
  sov_cond_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ sov_main * cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  sov_cond_comparison <- anova(main_effects_model, sov_cond_model)
  
  bedOrEnd_cond_model <- lmer(amplitude ~ bedOrEnd * cond + (1|subject), data = comp_data)
  bedOrEnd_cond_comparison <- anova(main_effects_model, bedOrEnd_cond_model)
  
  # Perform nested model comparisons
  null_vs_main <- anova(null_model, main_effects_model)
  main_vs_interaction <- anova(main_effects_model, interaction_model)
  null_vs_interaction <- anova(null_model, interaction_model)
  
  # Get estimated marginal means
  emm_sov_main <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ sov_main)
  emm_bedOrEnd <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd)
  emm_cond <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ cond)
  emm_sov_bedOrEnd <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd)
  emm_sov_cond <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ sov_main * cond)
  emm_bedOrEnd_cond <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd * cond)
  emm_three_way <- emmeans(interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd * cond)
  
  # Convert to data frames for plotting
  emm_sov_main_df <- as.data.frame(emm_sov_main)
  emm_bedOrEnd_df <- as.data.frame(emm_bedOrEnd)
  emm_cond_df <- as.data.frame(emm_cond)
  emm_sov_bedOrEnd_df <- as.data.frame(emm_sov_bedOrEnd)
  emm_sov_cond_df <- as.data.frame(emm_sov_cond)
  emm_bedOrEnd_cond_df <- as.data.frame(emm_bedOrEnd_cond)
  
  # Plots for main effects
  p1 <- ggplot(emm_sov_main_df, aes(x = sov_main, y = emmean)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "SOV (wn vs wm)", y = "Amplitude", title = "Main Effect of SOV") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(emm_bedOrEnd_df, aes(x = bedOrEnd, y = emmean)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Position (beg vs end)", y = "Amplitude", title = "Main Effect of Position") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  p3 <- ggplot(emm_cond_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Amplitude", title = "Main Effect of Condition") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Plots for two-way interactions
  p4 <- ggplot(emm_sov_bedOrEnd_df, aes(x = bedOrEnd, y = emmean, color = sov_main, group = sov_main)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Position", y = "Amplitude", title = "SOV × Position Interaction") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  p5 <- ggplot(emm_sov_cond_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, color = sov_main, group = sov_main)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Amplitude", title = "SOV × Condition Interaction") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  p6 <- ggplot(emm_bedOrEnd_cond_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, color = bedOrEnd, group = bedOrEnd)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Amplitude", title = "Position × Condition Interaction") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Three-way interaction plot
  # Convert the three-way EMM to data frame
  emm_three_way_df <- as.data.frame(emm_three_way)
  
  # Method 1: Faceted plot by sov_main and bedOrEnd
  p7 <- ggplot(emm_three_way_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, color = bedOrEnd, group = bedOrEnd)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(~ sov_main) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Amplitude", 
         title = "Three-way Interaction: SOV × Position × Condition",
         subtitle = "Faceted by SOV (wn vs wm)") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Method 2: Alternative view - faceted by condition
  p8 <- ggplot(emm_three_way_df, aes(x = bedOrEnd, y = emmean, color = sov_main, group = sov_main)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(~ cond) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Position (beg vs end)", y = "Amplitude", 
         title = "Three-way Interaction: SOV × Position × Condition",
         subtitle = "Faceted by Condition (Bl0T1 vs Bl0T2)") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # Display plots
  plots <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, ncol = 2)
  
  # Return results
  if(null_vs_interaction$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.05) {
    return(list(
      component = comp_name,
      null_vs_main = null_vs_main,
      main_vs_interaction = main_vs_interaction,
      null_vs_interaction = null_vs_interaction,
      sov_main_effect = sov_main_comparison,
      bedOrEnd_effect = bedOrEnd_comparison,
      cond_effect = cond_comparison,
      sov_bedOrEnd_interaction = sov_bedOrEnd_comparison,
      sov_cond_interaction = sov_cond_comparison,
      bedOrEnd_cond_interaction = bedOrEnd_cond_comparison,
      interaction_model_summary = summary(interaction_model),
      interaction_model = interaction_model,
      plots = plots
    ))
  } else {
    return(list(
      component = comp_name,
      null_vs_main = null_vs_main,
      main_vs_interaction = main_vs_interaction,
      null_vs_interaction = null_vs_interaction,
      message = "Null model is not significantly different from interaction model",
      plots = plots
    ))
  }
}

# Print results function
print_results <- function(results) {
  cat("\n__Results for", results$component, ":__\n")
  cat("____________________________________\n")
  
  cat("\n__Model Comparisons:__\n")
  cat("\nNull vs Main Effects Model:\n")
  print(results$null_vs_main)
  
  cat("\nMain Effects vs Interaction Model:\n")
  print(results$main_vs_interaction)
  
  cat("\nNull vs Interaction Model:\n")
  print(results$null_vs_interaction)
  
  if(!is.null(results$message)) {
    cat("\n", results$message, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n__Main Effects:__\n")
    cat("\nMain effect of SOV (wn vs wm):\n")
    print(results$sov_main_effect)
    
    cat("\nMain effect of Position (beg vs end):\n")
    print(results$bedOrEnd_effect)
    
    cat("\nMain effect of Condition:\n")
    print(results$cond_effect)
    
    cat("\n__Two-way Interactions:__\n")
    cat("\nSOV × Position Interaction:\n")
    print(results$sov_bedOrEnd_interaction)
    
    cat("\nSOV × Condition Interaction:\n")
    print(results$sov_cond_interaction)
    
    cat("\nPosition × Condition Interaction:\n")
    print(results$bedOrEnd_cond_interaction)
    
    cat("\n__Full model summary:__\n")
    print(results$interaction_model_summary)
    
    # Add emmeans analyses
    cat("\n__Estimated Marginal Means:__\n")
    
    cat("\nSOV (wn vs wm):\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main))
    
    cat("\nPosition (beg vs end):\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd))
    
    cat("\nCondition:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond))
    
    cat("\nSOV × Position:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd))
    
    cat("\nSOV × Condition:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * cond))
    
    cat("\nPosition × Condition:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd * cond))
    
    cat("\nThree-way interaction (SOV × Position × Condition):\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd * cond))
    
    # Add pairwise comparisons
    cat("\n__Pairwise Comparisons:__\n")
    
    cat("\nSOV (wn vs wm):\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main)))
    
    cat("\nPosition (beg vs end):\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd)))
    
    cat("\nCondition:\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond)))
  }
}

# Function to save results
save_results <- function(results, component_name) {
  # Save plots to PDF
  pdf(paste0(component_name, "_plots.pdf"), width = 12, height = 12)
  grid.arrange(results$plots)
  dev.off()
  
  # Save three-way interaction plot separately for better visibility
  pdf(paste0(component_name, "_three_way_interaction.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)
  # Extract the emmeans for three-way interaction
  emm_three_way <- emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd * cond)
  emm_three_way_df <- as.data.frame(emm_three_way)
  
  # Create a comprehensive three-way interaction plot
  p_combined <- ggplot(emm_three_way_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, color = interaction(sov_main, bedOrEnd), group = interaction(sov_main, bedOrEnd))) +
    geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "SOV-Position combination") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Amplitude", 
         title = paste(component_name, ": SOV × Position × Condition Interaction"),
         subtitle = "All combinations in one comprehensive view") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
  print(p_combined)
  dev.off()
  
  # Save text results to file
  sink(paste0(component_name, "_results.txt"))
  
  cat("\nResults for", component_name, ":\n")
  
  cat("\n__Model Comparisons:__\n")
  cat("\nNull vs Main Effects Model:\n")
  print(results$null_vs_main)
  
  cat("\nMain Effects vs Interaction Model:\n")
  print(results$main_vs_interaction)
  
  cat("\nNull vs Interaction Model:\n")
  print(results$null_vs_interaction)
  
  if(!is.null(results$message)) {
    cat("\n", results$message, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n__Main Effects:__\n")
    cat("\nMain effect of SOV (wn vs wm):\n")
    print(results$sov_main_effect)
    
    cat("\nMain effect of Position (beg vs end):\n")
    print(results$bedOrEnd_effect)
    
    cat("\nMain effect of Condition:\n")
    print(results$cond_effect)
    
    cat("\n__Two-way Interactions:__\n")
    cat("\nSOV × Position Interaction:\n")
    print(results$sov_bedOrEnd_interaction)
    
    cat("\nSOV × Condition Interaction:\n")
    print(results$sov_cond_interaction)
    
    cat("\nPosition × Condition Interaction:\n")
    print(results$bedOrEnd_cond_interaction)
    
    cat("\n__Full model summary:__\n")
    print(results$interaction_model_summary)
    
    # Add emmeans analyses
    cat("\n__Estimated Marginal Means:__\n")
    
    cat("\nSOV (wn vs wm):\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main))
    
    cat("\nPosition (beg vs end):\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd))
    
    cat("\nCondition:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond))
    
    cat("\nSOV × Position:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd))
    
    cat("\nSOV × Condition:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * cond))
    
    cat("\nPosition × Condition:\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd * cond))
    
    cat("\nThree-way interaction (SOV × Position × Condition):\n")
    print(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main * bedOrEnd * cond))
    
    # Add pairwise comparisons
    cat("\n__Pairwise Comparisons:__\n")
    
    cat("\nSOV (wn vs wm):\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ sov_main)))
    
    cat("\nPosition (beg vs end):\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ bedOrEnd)))
    
    cat("\nCondition:\n")
    print(pairs(emmeans(results$interaction_model, ~ cond)))
  }
  
  sink()
}
```

```{r}
N100_results <- analyze_component(N100_data, "N100")
P2_results <- analyze_component(P2_data, "P2")
N350_results <- analyze_component(N350_data, "N350")


print_results(N100_results)
print_results(P2_results)
print_results(N350_results)


# Save results for each component
save_results(N100_results, "N100")
save_results(P2_results, "P2")
save_results(N350_results, "N350")
```
